name: Staging on Newly Refinished Floors in Bellevue: What Not to Do
title-tag: Staging on Newly Refinished Floors: Bellevue Seller Guide
meta-description: Staging a Bellevue listing on fresh floors? Furniture at 48–72 hours, rugs at 7 days, never tape or rubber backing. The countdown that protects the finish.
post-summary: January 4, 2027 · A refinished floor is dry in hours but cures for a week — and staging crews live in that gap. The three mistakes that mark fresh finish (early rugs, dragged furniture, taped protection), the day-by-day countdown to photos, and how Bellevue sellers fit it all before market.
